claim.text: An opt-in native block-0 first-T0 history cache stores physical BF16 K/V and reads F32 values exactly matching the pinned upstream cache function on the fixed preblock fixture.

raw_artifacts.note: Local fixtures, binaries, logs and receipts are external to Git; hashes cannot recover missing bytes.

definition_of_done.expected: 71 CPU Crystal, 43 Python and 8 Metal examples pass; physical BF16 storage byte-exact and F32 reads pass unchanged 2e-5; 22 BF16 and 22 F32 preattention regressions exact; value mutations rejected; no tracked native in-chain allocations/readbacks/waits and one terminal drain under 10% memory guards.
definition_of_done.observed: All declared positive checks pass. Four history tensors exact; 22+22 regression tensors exact. Hash-repaired BF16 corruption is rejected (exit 1), F32-only corruption produces one mismatch (exit 2). Sixteen guarded commands meet their declared expected exits and sampled memory limits; the old-CLI negative is CPU-only and unguarded.

evidence.signal: Pinned causal_attention_with_cache_mp invoked for one T0 store and one poisoned read-only call; two consumer interceptions; no attention math. Stored prefix survives in-place zeroing of current Q/K/V.
BF16 K/V byte-exact; both 9,930,752-value F32 reads have zero maximum/RMS error and mismatches at atol=rtol=2e-5.
Current binary retains exact 14 main + 8 pre-QKV BF16 captures and exact 14+8 F32 controls on identical inputs.

Eight Metal examples distinguish physical cache from overwritten source and mutated cache, enforce lease after partial preattention failure, and retain workspace through a later cache-read chain drain.
Repaired artifact/tensor hashes do not hide changed BF16 storage or one changed F32 read value. CPU tamper tests also reject underreported cache bytes with a repaired accounting total.

Native history counters 0/0/0/1. Named diagnostic buffers 2,402,022,912 bytes including 119,169,024 cache/read bytes; opaque MPSGraph storage excluded. 6 GiB native process cap, cache-aware 10% floor and 64 MiB swap-growth limit; sampled native peak 1.559 GiB, minimum headroom 38.876 GiB, swap growth zero.
